methods.label: Tracking the swept surfaces
methods.explanation: When a right triangle is rotated through one full revolution about one of its legs, the hypotenuse sweeps out the lateral surface of a cone, and the other leg sweeps out the base, forming a cone.
methods.levelReason: Recognizing the surfaces swept by a rotating triangle is qualitative Grade 7 geometry.
